panels.title: HTTP attempts
panels.description: Physical HTTP attempts, including retries.

targets.query:
WITH chosen(resolution) AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 604800000) THEN 60
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 2592000000) THEN 600
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 7776000000) THEN 3600
    ELSE 86400
  END
)
SELECT SUM(request_count) AS value
FROM api_request_rollup, chosen
WHERE resolution_seconds = chosen.resolution AND bucket_start_ms >= $__from AND bucket_start_ms < $__to
  AND route_key IN (${route:sqlstring})
  AND method IN (${method:sqlstring})
  AND CAST(status_code AS TEXT) IN (${status:sqlstring})

targets.query:
WITH chosen(resolution) AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 604800000) THEN 60
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 2592000000) THEN 600
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 7776000000) THEN 3600
    ELSE 86400
  END
), agg AS (
SELECT (bucket_start_ms / 1000) AS time, SUM(request_count) AS n, MAX(elapsed_max_ms) AS max_ms,
 SUM(elapsed_le_25_count) AS le25, SUM(elapsed_le_50_count) AS le50, SUM(elapsed_le_100_count) AS le100,
 SUM(elapsed_le_200_count) AS le200, SUM(elapsed_le_350_count) AS le350, SUM(elapsed_le_500_count) AS le500,
 SUM(elapsed_le_750_count) AS le750, SUM(elapsed_le_1000_count) AS le1000, SUM(elapsed_le_1500_count) AS le1500,
 SUM(elapsed_le_2500_count) AS le2500, SUM(elapsed_le_5000_count) AS le5000, SUM(elapsed_le_10000_count) AS le10000,
 SUM(elapsed_le_30000_count) AS le30000
FROM api_request_rollup, chosen
WHERE resolution_seconds = chosen.resolution AND bucket_start_ms >= $__from AND bucket_start_ms < $__to
  AND route_key IN (${route:sqlstring})
  AND method IN (${method:sqlstring})
  AND CAST(status_code AS TEXT) IN (${status:sqlstring})

)

panels.title: Request latency breakdown
panels.description: Average measured request phases. This separates local throttling, upstream response time, body transfer, and decode work.

  SELECT CASE
